use IO.Std.write
use default

grid(size: int, random: System.Random) -> LIST[LIST[int]] is
    let rows = LIST()

    for _ in 1::size do
        let row = LIST()

        for _ in 1::size do
            row.add(random.next(1, 21))
        od

        rows.add(row)
    od

    rows
si

show_until_twenty(rows: LIST[LIST[int]]) is
    search: for row in rows do
        for value in row do
            write("{value,3}")

            if value == 20 then
                write_line()
                break search
            fi
        od

        write_line()
    od
si

show_until_twenty(grid(10, System.Random(20)))
